purpose: Define a bounded account-loss implementation candidate for a seven-day strategy that has no scientific stop, without inventing a stop or changing the frozen signal/exit rule.

candidate_loss_container.reason: Use isolated margin as the account-loss firewall rather than creating a synthetic strategy stop. One-times leverage minimizes liquidation/mapping distortion while the implementation is validated.

validation_budget.interpretation: This is an allocated validation-margin cap, not stop-based risk and not a claim that realized loss is mathematically guaranteed to equal exactly 0.10% in all exchange failure scenarios.
validation_budget.minimum_contract_feasibility_rule: If the MEXC minimum executable contract notional exceeds the frozen validation budget, micro-live is blocked rather than increasing the budget.

required_fail_closed_checks: account is configured for isolated margin for BTC_USDT
auto margin addition is confirmed disabled
no open BTC_USDT position or conflicting order exists
initial isolated margin does not exceed the frozen validation budget
order quantity respects contractSize/minVol/volUnit without rounding above budget
liquidation mechanics do not silently create a scientifically material implementation mismatch
fees/funding/slippage pass the separate MEXC friction gate
pre-trade receipt is persisted before authenticated transport

equivalence_gate.rule: Freeze 1x isolated candidate first; then test whether its liquidation/margin mechanics would materially alter the frozen seven-day scientific implementation. Do not choose leverage after seeing which value best preserves outcomes.

source_basis: MEXC documentation states isolated margin confines liquidation loss to the position initial/added margin rather than using available balance.
MEXC documentation states Auto Margin Addition can transfer additional available funds into an isolated position; therefore it must be disabled for this candidate.
MEXC contract detail confirms BTC_USDT supports the required perpetual/API mapping; authenticated account-state verification remains pending.
